sentences.text: 498A/406/304B/306/34 Of The Indian ... vs In Re : Ebrahim Mistry

21.02.2023 rejected C.R.M.(DB) No. 4521 of 2022 In Re:- An application for bail under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Deganga Police Station Case No. 303 of 2022 dated 04.05.2022 under Sections 498A/406/304B/306/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Deganga Police Station Case No. 303 of 2022
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: And In Re : Ebrahim Mistry ..... petitioner Ms. Sabnam Laskar ... for the petitioner Mr. Debabrata Chatterjee, learned APP Mr. Santanu Chatterjee ... for the State Supplementary affidavit is placed on record.
Learned Counsel appearing for the petitioner submits he is in custody for 283 days.
He renews his prayer for bail.
Learned Counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.
We have considered the materials on record.
Bail prayer of the petitioner was rejected on merits in September, 2022.
Delay in commitment is due to abscondence of co-accused who is a relation of the petitioner.
In view of the aforesaid facts, we are not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.
The application for bail is, thus, rejected.

(Ajay Kumar Gupta, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
